claims.claim_text: Officers responded to reports of a subject behaving erratically who may have been armed.
The subject was seated in the driver's seat of a vehicle.
The subject started the engine as officers approached.
Officers gave verbal commands in both English and Spanish.
The subject produced a firearm and fired two rounds toward officers.
I fired multiple rounds from my duty rifle.
Officers found two firearms: a handgun and a rifle.
Officers gave commands in both English and Spanish for the subject to turn off the vehicle and show his hands.
